author: Adammonzy
quote: The graphics are the only thing thats good about this game. The game is simply just unfinished unplayable and disappointing. The emount of bugs that I’ve encountered and the physics just not working, i cant say i enjoyed tha gameplay. The performance is at 30 fps cap and average FPS is about 25 fps with constant frame drops. The fact that we waited 13 for this and 2 billion dollars ware put in for this is just disappointing. I rly think this game will be good overtime if they fix the bugs and physics and release it to pc for better frame rates.
